description: This file defines a Retrofit API service interface for accessing category-related endpoints in an Android application. It includes method declarations for fetching category data, as well as a factory method to create a singleton instance of the API service with configurable base URL handling.

classes.name: ApiService
classes.description: Retrofit interface for category endpoints, defining a suspend function to fetch a list of ContentItem objects for a given category.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and configures a singleton instance of ApiService with a base URL determined from BuildConfig.API_BASE_URL, defaulting to a safe URL if invalid or not provided.
